description: This file is a shell script that runs a series of automated tests for the 'git format-patch' command and related functionalities. It contains test definitions, setup steps, and validation procedures for various features like patch formatting, headers, threading, cover letters, signatures, encoding, options handling, and output directories.

methods.name: check_patch
methods.description: Verifies that the given patch file looks like a valid email patch with correct headers, ensuring the patch has a proper structure.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Tests that the 'From' header in the generated patch matches the expected author format, including proper encoding for non-ASCII names.

methods.name: signature
methods.description: Generates a signature string based on the git version or a provided signature text.

methods.name: append_signoff
methods.description: Appends a Signed-off-by line to a commit and generates a patch with signoff headers to verify signoff handling.
